known_differences: Native Stitch desktop image uses Product instead of Platform navigation, a simplified hero composition and an invented org-acme monitoring path. The mobile image adds an invented error example and metrics. These remain preserved as native generations but are not the hosted draft.

The hosted draft uses current public Sentry HTML, styles, fonts and 40 media files. Original analytics, OAuth sign-up handling and Astro hydration scripts were removed; small local menu and tab disclosures were added. Animated Rive artwork, carousel, SDK selector and newsletter behavior remain unverified.

No rendered side-by-side comparison of the hosted draft against current official desktop/mobile pages was permitted in this work session. Exact visual parity and full responsive/interactive behavior remain unverified.
